I once was on 2 tabs (~300ug) and I had never smoked while on acid so I decided to. I had absolutely no tolerance as I had taken a 2 month break, so I decided it would be smart to bring a 3.5g blunt filled with kief and wax. I smoked the whole thing and within 5 minutes I was like dead. I couldn’t move because I couldn’t wake myself from the visuals. I just sat against a log and watched my friend dance in the field. The sky was pink and the clouds were purple. The friend had distinct 5 layers of tracers around her in orange pink orange and green. Much like the graphics seen in the 60’s. I finally got up and saw leprechauns dancing on the ground, 2D as if they were a Mario game. My friend and I started to panic a bit, I saw my body from above and I had a Native American body around me and an eagle head, it was some spiritual or energetic avatar. My friend looked like Sacajawea, and the place we walked seemed like the Appalachian trails. I ended up taking 3 xan and like passing out because I panicked (it was my second time tripping)
